evals.name: channel-audit-from-studio-data
evals.prompt: YouTube audit for 'Garage Woodworks' (14,200 subs, 96 videos). Studio last 28 days: traffic 52% search, 21% suggested, 9% browse, 11% Shorts feed, 7% external. Long-form CTR 3.1%, avg view duration 3:40 on ~14-min videos (26%). Retention curves show a 35% drop in the first 30 seconds (intro with channel jingle and 'welcome back'). Uploads: 1 long-form every ~10 days, Shorts random. Top videos are all 'how to build X' tutorials. Goal: 50k subs in 12 months.
evals.expected_output: Audit in the skill's format: search-driven channel, CTR and intro retention as the two gates, title/thumbnail rewrites with Test & Compare, intro restructure, a tutorial series with fixed slot, Shorts bridge from tutorial steps, cadence suited to the creator, KPIs.
assertions: Diagnoses search as the main source and recommends protecting searchable tutorials while improving suggested/browse via series and playlists
Flags CTR 3.1% as weak and provides concrete title rewrites and thumbnail concepts with a Test & Compare plan
Addresses the 35% first-30-second drop by removing the jingle/'welcome back' and starting with the payoff
Shorts strategy explicitly bridges to the long-form tutorials
Cadence recommendation is realistic (e.g. 1 long-form/week + 2–4 Shorts) with a fixed slot

evals.name: shorts-not-converting
evals.prompt: My Shorts get 200k–900k views each (cooking channel) but my long videos get 2k views and I gain maybe 50 subs per viral Short. Should I just stop making long videos?
evals.expected_output: Explains the Shorts-to-long-form conversion problem and the bridge tactics (related video link, topic match, open question, series), when Shorts-only is viable vs not for the goal, and metrics to watch in Studio.
assertions: Explains why Shorts audiences convert weakly and gives specific bridge tactics (related video link, same topic, ending question)
Discusses the trade-off honestly (Shorts-first channels exist) tied to the creator's goal rather than a blanket answer
Names the Studio metrics to track (subs from Shorts, long-form views from Shorts viewers, returning viewers)
Recommends long-form topics derived from the best-performing Shorts

evals.name: title-thumbnail-rewrites
evals.prompt: Give me better titles and thumbnail ideas for these three videos on my personal finance channel: 1) 'My thoughts on index funds (2026 update)' 2) 'Budgeting app review' 3) 'How I paid off debt'. Current CTR is 2.4%.
evals.expected_output: For each video 2–3 title options ≤60 characters with specific outcomes or curiosity gaps, a thumbnail concept with ≤3 words of text that complements rather than repeats the title, and a Test & Compare plan.
assertions: Each video gets multiple title options under ~60 characters with a specific payoff or number (placeholders where the number is unknown)
Thumbnail concepts carry different information from the title and use ≤3 words of text
Explains the CTR-impressions relationship briefly and proposes Test & Compare
Avoids clickbait the video cannot pay off
